text:
Maya: Quick kickoff — pen test scheduled Mon 2025-05-12 09:00 PT. Need to lock down retest choreography and access. Primary asks: (1) ephemeral RBAC roles for assessors, (2) KMS read-only proxy for evidence exports, (3) audit log retention snapshot. Can folks confirm owners and windows?
Sam: I'll own ephemeral roles. Planning 2h window with 1hr preflight. What perms do assessors need exactly?
Maya: They need read on logs, read on S3 evidence buckets, and describe/list on EKS namespaces. No write. Also access to the readroom for proof artifacts.
Liam: For KMS we can expose a proxy service with audit-only keys. It will allow Decrypt operations against evidence artifacts but we should limit to a specific key alias. I'll prepare a short-lived IAM role that assumes via STS.
Evelyn: Logging: we need a point-in-time snapshot exported to our audit S3 before the window and another at closure. Retain snapshots for 90 days for evidence. Who can run the export at T-30m?
Sam: I can trigger exports. Putting a runbook together now — will include commands and verification steps.
Maya: Important: red team wants to exercise privilege escalation attempts. We must ensure we have detection playbooks pinned. @security-monitoring, can you schedule a war-room observer?
Security-Monitoring: Yep — @jordan will join and stream Splunk/Kinesis alerts during the window. We'll add triggered dashboards for unusual IAM AssumeRole and KMS Decrypt patterns.
Jordan: Will add detection rules: >3 AssumeRole calls in 1m, KMS Decrypt outside of allowed CIDR, and multiple failed list/describe API calls. Also will enable verbose sampling for 30m after window.
Liam: KMS detail: I'll create alias kms/pt-evidence-2025-05-12 and a key policy that only allows the proxy role + security monitor. All Decrypts will be logged to CloudTrail and forwarded to the audit S3.
Maya: Remediation tracking: we'll use the pen-test board (TNT-4492). Each finding must include repro steps, risk, owner, ETA, and evidence of fix. Retest slots will be 48 hours after fix validation. Agree?
Evelyn: Agree. Also require a regression smoke for any change touching RBAC or KMS — please include a QA signoff before marking fixed.
Sam: For ephemeral RBAC I'll push a terraform plan to the staging account and tag it with pt-run/2025-05-12. Expires after 2 hours via lambda cleanup.
Maya: Cool. Two blockers: (A) legal needs the assessor NDA scanned into JIRA before access, (B) network team must confirm readroom VPN ACLs. Can owners confirm?
Legal-Bot: NDA checklist: assessor-scan complete -> add comment to ticket PT-2025. Please attach PDF.
Networking: ACLs ok but need the source IP ranges for the vendor. Send them and we'll apply before T-60m.
Vendor-Contact: Sending ranges now: 34.78.12.0/24, 34.78.13.0/24. Also confirm the vendor's contact for the window: alice@vendor.com
Maya: Thanks. Action items: Sam (ephemeral roles + runbook), Liam (KMS alias + proxy role), Jordan (detections + dashboards), Evelyn (snapshot exports + retention), Legal (verify NDAs), Networking (apply ACLs). I'll post a DRY-RUN on Fri 2025-05-09 09:00 PT. If no objections, proceed with provisioning.
Sam: No objections. I'll post the terraform plan link when ready.
Liam: I'll create the key and post the key ARN + IAM policy snippet.
Jordan: Dashboards and alert hooks will be live by Fri 08:00 PT.
Evelyn: Snapshot runbook will be in the ticket.
Maya: Thanks all. Tagging for follow-up: @sam @liam @jordan @evelyn @legal-bot @networking. :thumbsup:
